# ViraStack Start (full)

> `virastack` CLI (2.0), scaffold production-ready Next.js or TanStack Start apps with a feature-based layout, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, Vitest tests, ViraStack AI rules, design skills and optional ViraStack tools.

## Install / run

```bash
npx virastack@latest
npx virastack@latest init my-app --template nextjs --agent claude,cursor --tools mask,password --yes
```

Docs: https://virastack.com/start/docs; Index: https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt; Repo: https://github.com/virastack/start

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `init [name]` | Create a new project (interactive unless `--yes`) |
| `add <name>` | Add a ViraStack tool (`mask`, `password`, `address`, `ai`) or a module (`users`, `checkout-address`, `checkout-card`) to an existing project |
| `remove <module>` | Remove a module. Its packages stay. `--yes` also deletes files you changed |
| `add ai --agent <list>` | Add AI rules for the given coding tools |

## Flags

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <name>` | Project name (`.` = current directory) |
| `--template <name>` | `nextjs` or `tanstack` |
| `--agent <list>` | AI coding tools: `claude`, `cursor` (comma separated) or `none`. Default: both |
| `--tools <list>` | Comma-separated: `mask`, `password`, `address` |
| `--i18n` / `--no-i18n` | Multi-language templates on/off |
| `--yes`, `-y` | Non-interactive defaults |
| `--skip-install` | Skip package install (AI rules and skills are still added) |
| `--tr` | Turkish CLI prompts / success messages |
| `--telemetry-disable` | Disable anonymous usage tracking |
| `-v`, `--version` | Version |
| `-h`, `--help` | Help |

## Interactive questions

Order: template, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor; both selected by default), i18n, extra tools (Mask, Password, Address).

## Setup order

1. `git init`
2. Package install (skipped with `--skip-install`)
3. Next.js only: Next.js agent rules block in `AGENTS.md`
4. ViraStack AI: `npx @virastack/ai init --agent <list>` writes rules for the selected tools
5. Design skills (see below)
6. Initial commit

## Design skills

Installed in every project with the `skills` CLI (https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills), into `.agents/skills/` plus the selected agents (only `.claude/skills/` when Claude Code is the only tool):

- `emil-design-eng` from https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills
- `better-ui` from https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills
- `better-accessibility` from https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills

## Templates

Four variants:

1. `templates/nextjs`: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, no i18n by default
2. `templates/tanstack`: TanStack Start + Router, React 19, no i18n by default
3. `templates-i18n/nextjs`: Next.js + `next-intl`, messages in `src/messages/`
4. `templates-i18n/tanstack`: TanStack Start + Paraglide, messages in `src/messages/`

### Shared stack (typical)

- TypeScript strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` (`tsc` on TypeScript 7, `typescript-eslint` and `next build` on TypeScript 6), Node `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`
- Tailwind CSS 4 design tokens
- UI: Base UI (unstyled), shadcn `components.json`, Sonner, Lucide, `next-themes`, CVA
- Server state: TanStack Query 5
- Client state: Zustand
- URL state: `nuqs` on Next.js, `validateSearch` on TanStack Start
- Forms: React Hook Form + Zod
- API: `createApi({ baseUrl, getHeaders })` over native `fetch`, `api.get(path, { schema })` validates with Zod, `ApiError.kind` is `http`, `network`, `timeout` or `parse`
- Env: Zod schema in `src/env.ts` (no `@t3-oss/env-nextjs` required)
- Tests: Vitest, Testing Library, jsdom, MSW
- Tooling: ESLint 10, Prettier 3, Husky, Knip, Commitlint
- Agent: ViraStack AI v2 writes `.claude/rules/virastack/`, `.cursor/rules/virastack/`, an `AGENTS.md` block and `.virastack/ai.json` (see https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt)
- Intentionally omitted by default: Auth, DB/ORM, CSP

### Tests

- `vitest.config.ts` and `src/test/`: jsdom setup, a `renderWithProviders` helper and an MSW server that fails on unhandled requests
- Example test in `features/home`: a helper. `virastack add users` adds a helper, an API function with MSW and a component

### Architecture for agents

- Feature-based: default work under `src/features/[feature]/`
- No cross-feature imports; promote to `src/` only when a second feature needs it
- Shared constants live in `src/constants/`
- One alias: `@/*`. No barrels: import from the defining file. Shared folders must not import features or routes
- Scaffold includes a deletable start page in `features/home`, remove it when building the real app
- Search codebase for `FIXME:` after scaffold (site config, remote images, etc.)

### Formatting

`.prettierignore` lists the AI rule files and skills, so `pnpm lint:ci` does not reformat files that ViraStack AI tracks by hash.

## Modules

`npx virastack@latest add <module>` installs a working feature into `src/features/<module>` of a project created with Start 2.0 or newer: `users`, `checkout-address`, `checkout-card`. Modules run on a dummy API or dummy data; connecting a real API is the installer's work.

- It adds missing packages and `components/ui` components, and merges messages into `src/messages` in i18n templates. If a file or message already exists, nothing changes.
- It creates no page. Render the component from your own route. Each module has steps at `https://virastack.com/start/features/<module>`.
- Features cannot import each other, so a page such as `/checkout` renders `CheckoutAddress` and `CheckoutCard` and reads `useCheckoutAddress` and `useCheckoutCard`.
- `npx virastack@latest remove <module>` deletes its files, empty folders and messages. Packages and your page stay.

Docs: https://virastack.com/start/docs/modules

## Scripts

- Day-to-day: `pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm start`
- Quality: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` / `lint:ci`, `pnpm knip`, `pnpm format`
- Tests: `pnpm test` (once), `pnpm test:watch`
- CI order: `typecheck → lint:ci → knip → test → build`
